ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.tone: Plain imperative; no exclamation, no please.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: Button label; one line, never wraps. English is 5 characters; keep it a short verb phrase of similar width.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Removes the key binding so the action has no shortcut. Its accessible name is the longer "Clear {label}'s shortcut". Not "clear the screen".

ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.role: Button beside a shortcut field (shown only when changed)
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.tone: Plain imperative; no exclamation, no please.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: Button label; one line, never wraps. English is 5 characters; keep it a short verb phrase of similar width.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Restores the action's built-in key binding. Its accessible name is "Reset {label} to its default".

ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.role: Text shown inside a shortcut field while it is recording
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: Single-line status readout beside a value; truncates rather than wraps. English is 37 characters.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Instruction displayed in place of the chord while the field has focus and is capturing keys. "Esc" is the Escape key and stays as the key name.

ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: Section or list heading; one line, sentence case. English is 18 characters.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Heading of the section that lists the rebindable shortcuts. Same words as the sidebar entry.

ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.tone: Helpful explanatory prose in second person.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column (about 60-70 characters per line); no length cap, keep every fact. English is 150 characters.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Tells the user how to rebind: focus a field, press the keys; Esc cancels; Reset restores the default. "Reset" and "Esc" must match the button label and the key name. "Panel rail" is the vertical strip of panel icons beside the window.

ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.role: Text shown inside a shortcut field with no binding
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: Single-line status readout beside a value; truncates rather than wraps. English is 11 characters.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Shown when the action has no key chord. The real chord (for example Ctrl+K) is never translated, only this placeholder word.

ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.role: Accessible name of a shortcut field while it is recording
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.tone: Calm, factual sentence; no blame, no alarm.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.length: Screen-reader-only accessible name (not painted); length is free but keep it a natural spoken phrase. English is 32 characters.
ui.settings.shortcuts.keyboard_shortcuts.note: Spoken name. {label} is the action name, for example "Console" (an already-localised noun). Keep the colon-then-instruction order or reorder naturally.
